title: We have released a free pack of 20 retro songs created by our midi music generation model
author: black-magik-studios
selftext:
We're back again with more free stuff, Our past posts have been focused on our neural pixelate and tilemap tools but that's not all we've been building. We realized that we've been neglecting our music generation tools.

Sigil is our custom trained midi generation model that comes bundled with out midi editing tools. We created this small fast model to quickly generate loop able midi tracks that we can edit while we listen to it. The goal is to speed up the creation process not replace it and Sigil delivers allowing you to create brand new songs in under a minute allowing you to find the vibe you're looking for quickly and easily.

With our recent update of Sigil to v1.1.0 We've released a pack of 20 tracks generated by Sigil completely free and owned by you to put into whatever game you're working on.

You can download the song pack from our free [itch demo](https://blackmagikstudios.itch.io/sigil)
